definitions.explanation: An across-the-board increase in the base salary structure for employees. Often abbreviated to ベア. Distinct from individual merit raises or bonuses.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ベースアップ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was a base pay raise this year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{組合|くみあい}→組合：02669_kumiai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ベースアップ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{要求|ようきゅう}した→要求する：25533_youkyuusuru⟧。
examples.english: The union demanded a base pay raise.

examples.japanese: ⟦{物価|ぶっか}→物価：03607_bukka⟧⟦{上昇|じょうしょう}→上昇：11296_joushou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ベースアップ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{踏|ふ}み{切|き}った→踏み切る：06237_fumikiru⟧。
examples.english: In response to rising prices, many companies decided on base pay raises.

notes:
ベースアップ (often shortened to ベア) is wasei-eigo meaning an across-the-board raise in the base salary scale. It is a key term in Japanese labor relations, especially during {春闘|しゅんとう} (spring wage negotiations).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ベースアップ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{要求|ようきゅう}する→要求する：25533_youkyuusuru⟧: to demand a base pay raise
- ベースアップ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{踏|ふ}み{切|き}る→踏み切る：06237_fumikiru⟧: to decide on a base pay raise
- ベア⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧: base-up negotiations

ベースアップ VS {昇給|しょうきゅう}:
ベースアップ is a company-wide raise applied to the entire pay scale, while ⟦{昇給|しょうきゅう}→昇給：04687_shoukyuu⟧ refers to an individual salary increase, often based on seniority or performance.
